claim: Ranking screen writers or using a rounded buffer range can point at the copier or renderer variables; find the copier's own pointer for the exact buffer.

evidence.text: Masked actors and scenery compose into a 24-byte stride buffer, published by a stack copier; screen-writer ranking alone first emphasised the copier and menus.
The survey's rounded buffer range (0x5C80-0x673F) mixed the view buffer with renderer variables; the copier's pointer (LD HL,23740 at 0xA39A) gave the exact buffer.
